title: Machine and verifier definitions of BPP agree
statement: For the specified polynomial-time verifier model, the class of languages decidable in polynomial time by a finite-state randomized Turing machine with probability at least $2/3$ of producing the correct answer equals the class for which an efficient Boolean verifier, given a polynomial number of uniformly random bits, outputs the correct answer with probability at least $2/3$ on every input.
